title: The Dollar's Breakout: Where The Euro, Pound And Loonie Land Next
speaker: Drew Dosik (Verified Investing)

macro_themes.view: The US dollar is in breakout mode, driven by yields and efforts to taper the 10-year, pushing other currencies to key supports.

calls.reason: Broke out of a rising channel; overbought RSI near May 2025 pivot high 101.97 and fib 102.86, so expects a last push then consolidation.
calls.quote: I'm anticipating the dollar to be hitting the brakes on some of these gains in the very very near future

calls.reason: Daily RSI oversold at 24.63 at a pivot; expects a bounce/bear flag, then a drop to the 1.11 fib support and 2024 pivot highs.
calls.quote: I'm anticipating further breakdown on the Euro. However, near term, I'm anticipating this oversold scenario to get a little bit of reprieve

calls.reason: Oversold and due for consolidation before another leg lower to 1.30, a pivot low and top of 2024 consolidation.
calls.quote: it is too oversold in the near term and due for more consolidation before another leg lower happens.

calls.reason: Daily RSI 75.2 overbought but weekly not yet at 70; ideal case is 1-2 more weeks up to 1.42, consolidation above it, then a push to 1.45.
calls.quote: hit this $1.42 cent level, and then start consolidating... making room for another push higher to the buck 45 level
